method: The reviewed run is a read-only verification node (its manifest records 'commits: none' and 'changed_paths: none'), so no diff was landed and no gate suite exists for the landed-node rubric's six dimensions or its added-failure count; those fields are intentionally omitted. Its report is the run's own manifest.md, whose claims are the four brief-named runs. The three highest-ranked findings (gate 1 pure goldens, gate 2 live-graph refusal, gate 3 search_tools) were each re-run by taking the exact command the report cites and running it from the report's own directory. The report's cited commands are relative to the reviewed worktree; the reviewed worktree exists at 196d42191 and its tests/llm/test_signal_search_goldens.py, tests/llm/test_search_tools.py and the imas_codex/llm non-prompt source are byte-identical to this reviewer's worktree (git diff --stat 196d42191..HEAD changes neither), so the re-runs were executed in the reviewer's own worktree and read the same blobs the reviewed run did. Environment: UV_NO_SYNC=1, UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/home/ITER/mcintos/Code/imas-codex/.venv, PYTHONPATH=$PWD; the worktree .env resolves to /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/imas-codex/.env so the live-graph arm authenticated normally. Each run was captured whole to its own log under the review run's directory.
suite_delta_fields_omitted: added_failure_count and added_failure_ids are intentionally absent: the reviewed run landed no change and ran no gate suite.
